findings.risk: Score inflation via correlated concentration signals
findings.expected: decorrelate_contributions dampens all highly correlated signal pairs that share the same large-contract evidence (not only growth trio).
findings.observed: decorrelate_contributions only dampens quantity_growth/value_growth/diversity_increase. Top lead 59457959000101 fires agency_concentration (0.9036) and contract_concentration (0.7393) from the same dominant contract (share≈0.821), stacking ~1.64 points without dampening.
findings.impact: Priority CRITICAL can be inflated by double-counting concentration of one contract as both agency and contract concentration; ranking bias without false language claims.

findings.risk: Profile segment leakage — non-engineering / low-fit suppliers rank CRITICAL
findings.reproduction_command: python3 -c "import csv; rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('artifacts/campaigns/CONFENGE-COMMERCIAL-READY-01/run/commercial-leads.csv'))); print([(r['rank_position'], r['razao_social'], r['score_total']) for r in rows if any(x in r['razao_social'].upper() for x in ['CHURRASC','AUTO ','LIVIA','ANTONIO','PNEU','PECAS'])])"
findings.expected: CONFENGE engineering/services segments dominate commercial top-20; food/auto/MEI-name noise filtered or deprioritized.
findings.observed: Queue includes CHURRASCARIA E PIZZARIA CHOPINHO LTDA (#15), AUTO ELETRICA MENDES LTDA (#17), LIVIA BEATRIZ FRANCO DE SOUZA (#18), ANTONIO APARECIDO DOS SANTOS BOTUCATU (#19) all CRITICAL with score 9.5 — keyword ILIKE on objeto_contrato pulls incidental hits.
findings.impact: Operator wastes review capacity on low commercial fit; not identity fraud (CNPJs valid PJ/MEI) but weak profile adherence for human package.

findings.risk: Silent empty state_map if load_state_map fails — DNC suppression degrades without FAIL
findings.expected: Failure to load commercial state ledger fails closed (status FAIL/BLOCKED) or hard-requires override table presence before publishing queue.
findings.observed: pipeline.py wraps load_state_map in bare except Exception and sets state_map={}. Ranking then proceeds without DO_NOT_CONTACT suppression.
findings.impact: If ledger tables are missing/partial (or mid-migration error), previously suppressed DNC leads can re-enter published queue without explicit gate failure. Residual: not observed on this run (metrics.do_not_contact_suppressed=2).

findings.risk: persist_run always INSERT commercial_state='NEW'; list_leads/export_reviews keep DNC rows
findings.expected: DB row and list/export paths either omit DO_NOT_CONTACT from contactable queue or persist the human state used at ranking time.
findings.observed: persist_run hardcodes 'NEW' for every lead insert; package export uses state_map (correct). list_leads overlays DNC with suppressed=true but still returns the lead; export_reviews_csv writes it.
findings.impact: Consumers reading commercial_leads table without overrides may treat re-ranked leads as NEW. Post-run DNC still appears in review CSV export (not in ranked package run-result).

findings.risk: Authenticated sample is 60k filtered rows of 4.4M full table — ranking not universe-complete
findings.expected: Gate claims honest about sample vs full dump; ranking limitations visible (documented).
findings.observed: snapshot-manifest declares 60000 of 4438839 with filter 'engineering keywords LIMIT 60000'. Run PASS with AUTHENTICATED_REAL_SNAPSHOT. Not fixture fraud.
findings.impact: Suppliers outside sample never score; commercial queue is sample-relative. Documented residual, not false green on fixture.

findings.risk: Campaign quality gate FAIL (ruff/mypy/bandit) coexists with run gate PASS and stale RC_TECHNICAL_PASS narrative
findings.reproduction_command: python3 -c "import json; print('campaign', json.load(open('artifacts/campaigns/CONFENGE-COMMERCIAL-READY-01/campaign-gate.json'))['status']); print('run_gate', json.load(open('artifacts/campaigns/CONFENGE-COMMERCIAL-READY-01/gate.json'))['status']); print('result', json.load(open('artifacts/campaigns/CONFENGE-COMMERCIAL-READY-01/result.json')).get('technical_status')); print('security_bandit', json.load(open('artifacts/campaigns/CONFENGE-COMMERCIAL-READY-01/security.json')).get('bandit_ok'))"
findings.expected: Single consistent technical status across campaign-gate, gate.json, security.json, result.json.
findings.observed: campaign-gate.json status=FAIL (fails:[ruff,mypy,bandit]); gate.json PASS; security.json bandit_ok=true; result.json technical_status=RC_TECHNICAL_PASS with older run_id/top10 that still lists now-DNC CNPJs 07192414000109 and 02316749000500.
findings.impact: Risk of reading stale result.json as current technical green while campaign lint/security gate is red. Does not forge human ACCEPTED.

findings.risk: Human acceptance remains PENDING — CONFENGE_COMMERCIAL_READY non-claim holds
findings.expected: user-acceptance.json stays PENDING_HUMAN until Tiago signs; agents must not set ACCEPTED.
findings.observed: status=PENDING_HUMAN; note forbids agent ACCEPTED. No forgery.
findings.impact: Campaign cannot claim CONFENGE_COMMERCIAL_READY / DOD close; intentional residual blocker.

findings.risk: queue.suppress_repeat_days configured but not enforced in rank_leads/pipeline
findings.expected: Profile field suppress_repeat_days=30 suppresses recently published leads from re-queue.
findings.observed: Field present in confenge.yaml; no implementation in scoring/pipeline.
findings.impact: Same suppliers can reappear every cycle unless manually DNC/DISQUALIFIED.

findings.risk: Gate top10_cnpj_defensible checks only 14 digits, not check digits
findings.expected: Gate uses is_valid_cnpj14 for published top-10.
findings.observed: cli.py cmd_gate only verifies len==14 and isdigit. Identity path does full DV validation before grouping — residual defense-in-depth gap only.
findings.impact: If identity path were bypassed, gate would still pass length-only CNPJs.

findings.risk: DNC tests are pure unit rank_leads; no integration test for DB state_map failure path
findings.expected: Integration test: apply_review DNC → run_pipeline → package has no DNC; and load_state_map failure → FAIL.
findings.observed: Tests correctly assert rank_leads exclusion; package assertion is synthetic. Real run package evidence fills the gap for happy path only.
findings.impact: Vacuous-risk residual on exception path (see IR-ADV-03); happy-path DNC covered by unit + this run.

findings.reproduction_command: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; art=Path('artifacts/campaigns/CONFENGE-COMMERCIAL-READY-01'); print('HEAD/run', json.load(open(art/'run/run-result.json'))['git_sha']); print('gate', json.load(open(art/'gate.json'))['git_sha']); print('result', json.load(open(art/'result.json'))['git_sha']); print('ua', json.load(open(art/'user-acceptance.json'))['git_sha']); print('soak_deploy', json.load(open(art/'soak-non-interference.json'))['final_deploy_sha'])"
findings.expected: Release artifacts pin one git_sha consistent with reviewed code.
findings.observed: run-result + gate + campaign-gate use 5e0ad0f... (matches branch HEAD). result.json/user-acceptance still bab090aa...; soak deploy_sha 4ab5c43.... Not migrations-skipped false green: run migrations.skipped=false.
findings.impact: Audit confusion; not code integrity failure of the current package.

group_by_supplier requires resolve_supplier eligible + valid cnpj14 (DV). No name-based cross-CNPJ merge.
Growth dampening only; concentration pair stacks.
snapshot.validate rejects fixture/synthetic; run status AUTHENTICATED_REAL_SNAPSHOT; tests/test_snapshot.py rejects fixture.
isolation fail-closed local 5441; soak-non-interference.json ok=true interference=false production_touched=false soak_touched=false.
FORBIDDEN_LANGUAGE enforced on profile; package language_note disclaims conversion; occurrences of 'probabilidade de compra' only as non-claim/disclaimer text.
Current run git_sha matches HEAD; migrations.skipped=false. Secondary result.json/ua SHA drift (low).
gate top10_has_signal/provenance true; each top lead has signals_fired and evidence arrays.
user-acceptance.json PENDING_HUMAN; agent note forbids ACCEPTED.

Identity/scoring/DNC/isolation tests assert real outcomes; residual lack of DB-integrated DNC failure-path test.
